title: SR-5.04 Paid tiers sell only what is built, on every surface
request: Closes G45: The $12 tier advertises automatic merge, which does not exist; the pricing test covers docs but not the site. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Pricing truth from one table
requirements: a machine-readable status table (built, planned, date) is the single source; docs and the site render from it
a feature listed in a paid tier must be built or carry a delivery date

the status table carries a tiers section: each tier's name, its monthly and yearly prices in each currency the docs show, and its computer and member limits, equal to the pricing table in docs/PRICING.md, so the site renders every tier fact from the copy QL-1.06's gate sync brings in; the trial's size is a separate entry, never a tier limit

every service the tiers docs sell (setup, support, the rate-card services in docs/tiers/services.md) is a status-table row marked staffed or not staffed; a service that is not staffed is shown as planned in docs and in the exported site data, never as sold

the status table carries one positioning entry, the tagline, first the README's line (Shared context and coordination for the AI tools you already use) until the owner chooses another; the README's bold tagline equals it
docs/PRICING.md's table gives each price in USD and in CHF, as README.md and docs/SOLUTIONS.md already state them, and test/pricing-docs.test.mjs accepts both forms

the status table has one row for each AI app memev connects (each client id that src/cli/clients.mjs defines) marked built, and a planned row for each app or provider that the docs or the site name as coming

criteria.statement: A planned feature shown as included in any tier fails, in docs and in the exported site data

SR-5.04 surfaces: every sentence of site/web/*.html (tags stripped, entities decoded), README.md and docs/**/*.md that contains a claim phrase of a planned row of docs/status.json also contains the whole word 'planned'. For the merge row the phrases include at least 'nothing to resolve', 'automatic merge', 'merges changes made in several places' and 'full merge engine'. A section tag in a sibling element does not count. Red at base on site/web/personal.html:56 and site/web/video.html:46. A fixture copy of personal.html with 'Automatic merge across your computers.' added under the $12 price fails, naming the page. The contract scope must be amended to add site/web/**, README.md, docs/CONVERGENCE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/LICENSING-NOTICE.md.
